caption: The drawing consists of a square pattern with green and off-white as the primary colors. Centered and repeated in the composition are four large green four-leaf clover shapes, each situated within its own section and connected by straight lines meeting at corners with small green heart-like forms. In between the clovers, circular star motifs with radiating lines occupy the gaps where the four clovers meet. At the bottom and left borders, there is a pronounced band composed of alternating green heart shapes and diagonal green lines. A thin green border frames the entire design. Curved lines, small green circles, and a larger arched braided pattern appear within the lower-left quadrant. The off-white background features closely drawn, angled lines creating a textured geometric backdrop behind the green shapes.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
